from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection, capturing its identity and its outgoing references to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the current paper being parsed")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of other provided papers that this paper references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
